purpose: Provide a finite-archive parent fallback that is independent of ideal SAFE-MIX regret claims.

claim_boundary.proved_by_construction_after_valid_execu: The selected framed archive is the smaller of two independently completed valid payload alternatives under the frozen frame contract.
not_proved_by_construction: a smaller complete counted score after union package cost
runtime eligibility after sequential dual encoding

activation_dependencies: A memory-safe authoritative parent has an exact archive, inverse, resource, package, and dependency receipt.
The Gamma candidate has an independent exact archive, inverse, resource, package, and dependency receipt on the identical sealed population.
Both alternatives use the identical reversible frontend and raw target identity, or their distinct frontends are both included and mode-selected inside the counted package.
The combined decoder closure and mode frame are materialized before selection authority is granted.
No exclusive full-corpus lease is active on the execution host.

execution_contract.scratch_isolation: separate clean alternative directories under one counted execution boundary
execution_contract.input_identity: same sealed byte population and SHA-256 for both alternatives
execution_contract.selection_time: only after both encodes and both exact inverses terminalize
execution_contract.selection_metric: final framed archive bytes for the frozen population
execution_contract.failure_rule: If one alternative is invalid, it is ineligible; if P is invalid, the wrapper is invalid even when C passes.
execution_contract.retention: retain both complete receipts; retain only the selected payload in the final framed archive
execution_contract.repeat: repeat the complete dual-encode selection and require mode and archive byte identity

frame_contract.payload_interpretation: selected alternative decoder receives exactly payload_bytes bytes

conditions: A_P and A_C are complete alternative payload byte lengths before the selection frame
both alternatives are valid under the execution contract
no alignment or container padding exists beyond the declared frame
the tie rule is applied exactly
finite_archive_envelope.package_rule: P_union is the actual byte size of every program, model, table, frame decoder, and dependency required to decode either emitted mode; shared bytes are counted once and no hypothetical deduplication is credited.
finite_archive_envelope.authority: Only measured A_select and measured P_union determine score.

resource_contract.peak_rule: maximum observed process-tree peak across wrapper, P, C, frame construction, and verification
resource_contract.scratch_rule: maximum live logical and allocated bytes across both isolated alternative directories plus retained best payload
resource_contract.runtime_rule: complete wall and CPU accounting includes both encodes, both decodes, selection, framing, verification, and cleanup
resource_contract.cleanup_rule: both alternative scratch directories and transient unselected payload are removed only after their identities and sizes are frozen

identity: P contract, package, binary, and receipt SHA-256
C contract, package, binary, and receipt SHA-256

controls.K: Construct and decode a P-mode frame around the exact P payload; the extracted payload and raw inverse must equal standalone P.
controls.T: Flip the mode byte without changing the payload; decode must fail or produce a noncanonical inverse and must never verify.
controls.L: Alter payload_bytes without changing the payload; decode must fail closed.
controls.R: Repeat the complete selector; selected mode and every archive byte must match.

required: P, C, and selected frame exact inverses pass
complete counted score is at most 105000000 bytes

reason_execution_is_forbidden: No eligible memory-safe parent and Gamma candidate pair is terminally bound, and Arm B remains active.
